adaptationNotes.data: Showcase bots, people, sample messages, model catalogs, simulated progress and timers are excluded. Controllers supply real workspace, directory, task, delivery and recovery state.
adaptationNotes.navigation: Sidebar rail layout uses real router links. Desktop can hide the rail; narrow viewports use the Arc drawer and retain the product's messages, tasks and settings tabs.
adaptationNotes.conversation: Thread observation keeps a visible history anchor, follows streaming only at the bottom and exposes unread/latest navigation. Composer preserves keyboard submission, draft callbacks, attachment validation and explicit stop.
adaptationNotes.decisions: Approval rows keep every real allow, reject, retry and reconciliation callback. Unknown results remain unknown until product operations reconcile them.
adaptationNotes.forms: Controls import the pinned Arc API directly. Optional select values use an internal prefix, including the empty string. Required selects keep a real empty value and a placeholder until a product option is selected. Product callbacks receive the original value.
adaptationNotes.navigationActions: RoutedAction and ActionLink use the pinned Arc button CSS module on real anchors to preserve href, modified clicks and router navigation without nesting interactive controls.
adaptationNotes.nativeElements: Native video, hidden attachment picker, details/summary, and data-driven settings/navigation rows preserve their platform semantics. Bot face artwork remains domain content and follows data-theme.
